chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Rifa'ah ibn Musa al-Nakhhas, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him). I said: 'I buy a slave girl, and she stays with me for months without menstruating, and that is not due to old age. I show her to the women, and they tell me, 'She is not pregnant.' So is it permissible for me to have intercourse with her in her private part?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Menstruation can be withheld by the wind (or windiness) without pregnancy, so there is no problem if you touch her in the private part.' I said: 'But if she is pregnant, what is for me from her?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'If you intend so, in what is besides the private part.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on having intercourse with a non-menstruating slave girl if she is pregnant?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) addresses the fiqh of 'hayd ma'rufah' (regular menstruation) where a slave girl fails to menstruate due to a medical condition rather than age or pregnancy. He permits vaginal intercourse if pregnancy is ruled out by female examination, but advises non-vaginal intimacy if she is pregnant, reflecting the practical legal reasoning of the Imams regarding bodily purity and marital rights in the context of slavery.
